name: Midas mTBILL
oneLiner: mTBILL is Midas's NAV-accreting tokenized U.S. T-Bill fund via BlackRock IB01 ETF, FMA-regulated rails, with daily Ankura Trust NAV attestations.
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury Bills (maturity <3 months) via a reference basket of T-Bill ETFs and tokenized funds, primarily BlackRock iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF (IB01), plus BUIDL; atomic redemption sleeve via tokenized money-market funds (USTB, BUIDL, JTRSY, FAST) within available liquidity; physical custody by Maerki Baumann & Co. AG (Switzerland); security ring-fencing by ATG Azimut Treuhandgesellschaft mbH; target return = 8-week U.S. T-Bill yield minus ~50 bps
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting token (not pegged to $1); price launched at ~$1.00 and appreciates continuously as T-bill yield accrues; permissioned mint/redeem at daily NAV via Midas smart contracts in USDC/USDT or fiat; NAV oracle published daily by Ankura Trust Company

jurisdiction.regulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority only; issuer not FMA-licensed)
jurisdiction.license: EU-Prospectus-Regulation-approved tokenized debt instrument (MiFID II financial instrument); EEA-passported; not available to U.S. or UK retail persons

applicabilityBasis.summary: mTBILL is a Liechtenstein Derivative Debt Instrument (blockchain-based certificate) classified as a MiFID II financial instrument/security, issued by Midas Software GmbH under EU Prospectus Regulation with prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA. The GENIUS Act's definition of 'payment stablecoin' explicitly excludes digital assets that are securities under federal securities laws; mTBILL's fluctuating NAV, yield-bearing structure, and classification as a debt security place it squarely outside the payment-stablecoin perimeter. mTBILL is also not offered to US persons.

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority for Liechtenstein Derivative Debt Instrument; issuer domiciled in Germany under EU Prospectus Regulation / MiFID II financial-instrument framework)
genius.notes: mTBILL is a tokenized debt instrument (Blockchain-based Certificate) classified as a MiFID II security under European law, with prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA on 17 July 2024 (renewed July 2025). Issuer is Midas Software GmbH (Berlin, Germany); the FMA approved only the prospectus under EU Prospectus Regulation — the issuer is not licensed or registered with the FMA. mTBILL is not a payment stablecoin under the GENIUS Act: its value is NAV-accreting (fluctuating, not stable), it pays yield to holders, it is structured as a debt security, and it is explicitly not offered to US persons. The GENIUS Act's definition of 'payment stablecoin' excludes securities under federal securities laws, placing mTBILL entirely outside the Act's scope.

mintAuthority.summary: mTBILL is minted exclusively by the Midas DepositVault (proxy 0x9936…) holding M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE in the shared MidasAccessControl (0x0312…). DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by a 1-of-3 Midas Safe and an EOA. Proxy upgrades require a 2-day MidasTimelockController (0xe3ee…). No permissionless mint route exists.

review.evidence: All five Midas mTokens share MidasAccessControl at 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b (TransparentUpgradeableProxy → MidasAccessControl impl 0xDd5a…). At block 25295093: (1) M_TBILL_MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE (keccak256) held only by DepositVault proxy 0x9936…; (2) DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (0x0000…) held by Safe 0xb608… (1-of-3, no modules/guard) and EOA 0xd419…; (3) shared ProxyAdmin 0xbf25… owned by MidasTimelockController 0xe3ee… with 2-day min delay. No permissionless mint route. The EOA co-holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is a structural risk but does not prevent verification.
